_comment: Host semaphore gates (#9231). registered_runners = every self-hosted runner registered for this repository on both nodes (names from the runners API). A gate's slots = the HOST_SEMAPHORE_SLOTS of the gated leg in .github/workflows/ci.yml; serving_runners = the registered runners that carry the leg's label and can run it. Rules (scripts/ci/host_slots_check.py, run by CI in the shard-partition unit test step and pinned by the #9231 unit tests): serving_runners is a subset of registered_runners and len(serving_runners) <= slots, so a job that holds a runner always finds a slot. scripts/ci/host_semaphore.py reads serving_runners at run time and ends with the named outcome infra-unknown-runner when RUNNER_NAME is not listed there. Adding a runner with the label needs a slot first.
